address: 443 Guangfu North Road, Liwan, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: The owner was behind a legendary, now-shuttered restaurant, and opened this much smaller spot, keeping some of the menu's most popular items. The chef has decades of experience and his Hakkanese cooking is a pure delight. The signature poached chicken, using birds from Qingyuan, boasts robust flavour and juicy flesh; scallion and sand ginger dips elevate the dish further. The house-made pickles and white radish pork balls, are also recommended....
